skills.title: Motivation and Trigger Expansion for Why-Decisions
skills.trigger_conditions: Use when a why-question asks about someone deciding to start, create, launch, or change a venture, and retrieved snippets mention the venture but not the underlying cause.
applicable_question_patterns: Why did someone decide to start their own business/store/project?
What motivated a person to launch a venture?
Why did a person choose a new career or entrepreneurial path?
What circumstances led to starting a business?
skills.action_instructions: Add complementary queries targeting causal language, personal motivations, prior setbacks, passions, and stated reasons. Search both early background sessions and later reflective explanations; do not rely only on snippets containing the venture name.
skills.evidence_requirements: do not use gold evidence at inference
failure_modes: Retrieving only later business updates while missing origin context
Overweighting generic risk/reward comments without causal details
Assuming the answer is in the same session as the first mention of the venture
Ignoring paraphrases such as passion, love, blend, perfect match, or job loss
query_templates: {entities} passionate about love for unique interests blend
{entities} lost job unemployment before starting business
{entities} why started own store perfect match
